Sir '''Ferdinand of Theramore''' is a human located at the [[Jousting Grounds]] in [[Northwind]]. One of the participants in the Northwind jousting tournament representing the [[Theramore|nation of Theramore]], he faces off against Sir [[Estanor of Dalaran]].
